title: ALERT: GETTING READY TO SHORT EVERYTHING...
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Nasdaq at all-time highs while bond yields flash red flags is unsustainable.
Markets are stretched; a correction is expected eventually, a time to prepare to short or hold cash.
Toshiba supply increase is a catalyst that may hurt WDC and memory names.

calls.reason: Nasdaq at all-time highs and incredibly overbought amid high yields, oil, inflation and Middle East risk; prepares to short a pullback, citing a ~7.5% drop back to the 700 QQQ prior low as possible; long term markets more bullish than bearish.
calls.quote: markets are at all-time highs, we're incredibly overbought and this is my favorite time to prepare for markets to pull on back.

calls.reason: Bearish direction even while Nasdaq is bullish; down ~50% from ~800 high after Toshiba supply news; traded it short intraday (+$4,200) but would not hold overnight.
calls.quote: I don't personally see as of right now Western Digital to be a good investment.

notes: 'Happy Monday' -> Mon Oct 5 (listing Oct 6); same-day follow-up to e4Jg-HLUiOk. QQQ 700 is a hypothetical pullback level ('if it were to return to previous lows of 700'), kept as support not target. MSTR short (lost $453) skipped. Long-term holds MU/AAPL/NVDA mentioned generically.
